authorizationIssues.provider_unauthorized: The provider rejected the credential used to collect metrics. Reconnect the same account and check permissions.

scheduler.composeHint: Choose a draft, channels and a future time. Scheduling is confirmed only after every job is saved; it does not mean the provider has published it.
scheduler.localTimezone: Local time in this browser; stored in UTC.
scheduler.noEligibleChannels: No channels are available for scheduling.
scheduler.scheduleInvalid: Choose a draft, 1 to 20 available channels and a valid future time.
scheduler.outcomeUnknown: Execution has no final confirmation. Check the provider before publishing again.
scheduler.providerAckPending: An external ID exists; this job will not be automatically republished. Check the provider.
scheduler.capabilityError: Publication configuration could not be verified.
scheduler.capabilityLabel: Publication configuration (does not confirm provider approval or OAuth validity):
scheduler.simulatedWarning: simulation mode — nothing is actually published
scheduler.reason_direct_post: Direct Post required; inbox delivery is not publication
scheduler.reconciliationHelp: Confirmation checks read the original delivery and never create another post. Only attempts interrupted before starting a send can be automatically requeued. After 20 checks or 7 days without confirmation, manual review is required. Queue execution is limited to 3 publications per call to bound memory and provider pressure.
scheduler.reconcilePendingHelp: The preserved reference will be checked with progressive backoff. This check never sends the post again.
scheduler.closedReviewHelp: Manual decision; neither publication nor absence at the provider is certified. No post was resent or deleted.
scheduler.closeReviewDescription: This owner/admin decision closes only the internal review and is audited. It does not mark the publication as successful.
scheduler.closeReviewWarning: First check the account and publication at the provider. Closing does not undo an existing post. Scheduling again is a separate action and may create a duplicate if your review is incorrect.
scheduler.closeReviewNote: What did you verify at the provider?
scheduler.closeReviewNoteHint: 20 to 1000 characters. Do not include tokens, passwords or sensitive information.
scheduler.closeReviewChecked: I checked the result at the provider and understand that closing does not confirm success, prove absence or resend content.
scheduler.reviewClosed: Review closed and audited, without resending or marking as published.
scheduler.noCheckDue: No check is available yet. Wait for the indicated interval and refresh the queue.
scheduler.checkedSummary: Provider queries: {{queries}} · {{confirmed}} confirmed, {{pending}} awaiting confirmation, {{review}} for review; {{requeued}} unsent attempt(s) recovered.
scheduler.legacyReferenceHelp: Legacy reference without a validated type. It may identify an upload/container, not a public post. Manual provider review is required.
scheduler.configurationEmpty: No integrations were reported. Check the configuration before trying to schedule.
scheduler.configurationScope: Configuration does not confirm OAuth access, permissions or provider approval. Your channels are checked in the scheduling form.

analytics.title: Metrics, trends and channels
analytics.subtitle: Review collected channel records with clear sources and limitations.
analytics.emptyTitle: No metrics collected in this period
analytics.emptyText: Metrics require actual published posts on authorized channels. Review the requirements above or choose a wider period. Charts are never filled with demonstration data.
analytics.syncHelp: Reads up to 25 recent posts per channel from the last 30 days and may consume provider quotas. A channel date identifies its last saved observation, not completion of every post.
analytics.ownerRequired: Only owners and administrators can start collection.
analytics.connectToMeasure: To enable collection, authorize a channel via OAuth with an implemented metrics collector.
analytics.reason_no_channels: No channels have been registered in this workspace.
analytics.reason_oauth_required: Channels are registered, but none is authorized via OAuth. Manual registration does not enable collection.
analytics.reason_unsupported: Connected channels do not support per-post collection in this version. Metrics will not be invented.
analytics.reason_no_posts: There are no actual published posts to measure yet. Drafts and simulated publications do not count.
analytics.reason_not_collected: There are actual published posts, but no collection records yet.
analytics.syncSuccess: Collection confirmed · Posts read: {{posts}} · Confirmed saves: {{records}}
analytics.syncError_one: Collection had {{count}} kind of warning and no confirmed saves. Review the details.
analytics.syncError_other: Collection had {{count}} kinds of warning and no confirmed saves. Review the details.
analytics.syncFailed: The collection outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh the data before trying again.
analytics.noNewCollection: No saves were confirmed in this run. Without a saved observation, the collection date does not advance.
analytics.lastRun: Last run — posts read: {{posts}} · confirmed saves: {{records}} · no observation: {{unavailable}}
analytics.weeklyDescription: Seven days compared with the previous seven.
analytics.weeklyContents: PDF and CSV with completed posts per channel, cumulative metrics from the latest collection in the week, and a comparison with the previous week’s collection. Repeated collections are not added together or treated as interactions occurring that week.
analytics.reportLanguage: PDF and CSV files are generated in Portuguese in this version.
analytics.emailUnavailable: Automatic email delivery requires a transactional provider, which has not been configured.
analytics.reportSessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to download the report.
analytics.reportFailed: Unable to generate a valid file. Please try again.
analytics.reportNetworkError: Network error or timeout while generating the report. Please try again.
analytics.snapshotCaveat: New collections retain the highest observed counter for each post and channel on a UTC day. Totals use the latest collected day without adding repeat reads; they are not new daily interactions or unique people. Downward corrections may appear only on the next day.
analytics.syncError: No metric saves were confirmed. Review the warnings.
analytics.syncPartial: Partial collection: {{records}} confirmed saves. Some reads failed or data was unavailable; review the warnings.
analytics.outcome_error: Collection had failures — save not confirmed
analytics.skippedTitle: Posts or channels without a collection
analytics.syncSkip_no_publications: no recent actual publications to measure.
analytics.syncSkip_unavailable: one or more posts returned no observation; no zero was invented.
analytics.syncIssue_publication_read_failed: Recent publications for this channel could not be read.
analytics.syncIssue_authorization_unavailable: A valid authorization could not be confirmed. Review the channel warnings.
analytics.syncIssue_rate_limited: The provider limited collection. The remaining posts were not measured.
analytics.syncIssue_provider_unauthorized: The provider refused the credential used for this collection. Refresh the channel before trying again.
analytics.syncIssue_authorization_record_failed: Authentication failed; the authorization state could not be confirmed in the database.
analytics.syncIssue_collection_failed: Metrics could not be obtained for one or more posts on this channel.
analytics.syncIssue_invalid_metrics: The provider returned invalid metrics; those values were not saved.
analytics.syncIssue_additional_metrics_unavailable: Post metrics were obtained, but some additional metrics were unavailable.
analytics.syncIssue_persistence_unconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. It was not retried automatically; refresh the data before trying again.
analytics.syncIssue_authorization_changed: Authorization changed during collection. The stale observation was refused; refresh the channel.
analytics.syncIssue_publication_changed: The publication changed or is no longer available. The observation was refused; refresh the data.

bestTime.title: Timing suggestion
bestTime.intro: Choose a context before checking. A suggestion does not schedule a post or certify a channel connection.
bestTime.contextHint: This choice only affects the suggestion; it does not change channels in the scheduling form.
bestTime.zoneHint: Windows are calculated in this zone. The form still uses the browser’s local zone; no workspace time zone is changed.
bestTime.optionsError: Channels could not be read. We will not treat this failure as an empty workspace.
bestTime.error: The suggestion could not be confirmed. Refresh to try again; default windows were not presented as the result of this failure.
bestTime.noSelection: No platform or account was assumed. Choose a channel or a generic reference.
bestTime.selectAgain: The chosen context is no longer available. Please select again.
bestTime.referenceReason: Generic editorial reference for the platform, without using account history.
bestTime.channelBaselineReason: Attributed records: {{count}}. There is not enough eligible evidence or comparable signal to rank windows by results; using an editorial reference.
bestTime.observedReason: Attributed history for this channel: {{count}} sends; {{samples}} support this window. This is a relative comparison, not a reach forecast.
bestTime.fillOnly: Only fills the date and time. Review the content and channels, then confirm scheduling separately.
bestTime.expired: This window is too close or has passed. Refresh the suggestion before using it.
bestTime.readonly: You can view suggestions. Editing access is required to fill or create scheduled posts.
bestTime.cadenceReason_low_budget: With {{hours}} hours available per week, start with a small target and adapt it to your routine.
bestTime.cadenceReason_daily_budget: With {{hours}} hours available per week, a daily post is a reference, not an obligation.
bestTime.cadenceReason_beginner: A conservative starting reference. Adjust it to your routine; this is not a promise of growth.
bestTime.cadenceReason_platform_default: An editorial reference for the platform, not a reach forecast or an obligation to publish.
bestTime.methodTitle: Source and limits of the suggestion
bestTime.method: History includes completed publications with an external ID and persisted observations attributed to the same channel, content and send. Recorded send start is a timing proxy, not the exact instant a post went public. Each publication’s latest cumulative collection counts only once.
bestTime.threshold: To use history in the ranking: at least {{total}} attributed sends, {{perSlot}} per window and comparable positive signal. Default windows are not personalized data.
bestTime.historyScope: Scope: up to {{max}} completed sends in the last {{days}} days. This is not the account’s entire history.
bestTime.rateBasis: Rates use the same denominator for every record: impressions, or reach when complete. Without comparable coverage, counts are used instead.
bestTime.countBasis: Comparison uses engagement counts for every record: part of the history had no positive denominator. Counts and rates were not mixed.
bestTime.noGuarantee: The ordering also considers waiting time. This heuristic does not measure percentage gains, guarantee performance, or confirm OAuth access or provider approval.

strategy.instagram: Try a clear opening and review media requirements and link destinations before publishing.
strategy.facebook: Use a clear message and invite conversation. Review link destinations and channel requirements.
strategy.youtube: Align the title, thumbnail and video opening. Check format and requirements before scheduling.
strategy.tiktok: Provide context early in the video and check media and Direct Post requirements.
strategy.linkedin: Explain the main idea early and review media and link requirements.
strategy.google_business: Consider search intent and the selected location. Review the offer, validity and call to action.
strategy.x: Review concision, context and format limits. A planning reference does not enable publishing.
strategy.threads: Prioritize conversation and clarity. A planning reference does not enable publishing.
strategy.pinterest: Use clear titles and descriptions for search. A planning reference does not enable publishing.
